rival_reading: Officials could issue this schedule during emergency restrictions; a water allotment and revocable access do not prove the program malfunctioned.
gloss: A field access credential records water allocation and a closure-based return rule.
title: Rosa Salcedo
body: Field rounds four to six. Water share is logged at shift end; access expires at road closure.

rival_reading: A response crew could mark work rows and collect tools after closing the road; the map and returned shovel do not establish an earlier malfunction.
gloss: A field-round mark falls after a road closure while a tool count is complete.
title: Field tally remains open
body: Rosa's second field-round mark is dated after the road closed. A child's drawing is tucked inside the map; the only completed count is shovels returned, not rows checked.
